content: Kain ve Abel
Muri ghoro, Adam yesuru azuwa tigheen ve Eva apo. Ye ipoop natu tamoot ve iwaat iza Kain. Ve isaav ighaze: “Maaron iuul ghou, tauto napoop natug tonene.”
Tinepneep le muri ghoro, Eva ipoop Kain tazi Abel. Yesuru tinim ndolman, ghoro Abel iŋginŋgin sipsip, ve Kain ighamgham uraat pa uum.
Sawa eez, Kain igham aniiŋ anoŋa pida to tivot ila uum toni inim watooŋrau pa Yoova.
Ve Abel paam irab sipsip toni ndinatu aidaba pida, ve igham suruvudi to popoia kat ila pa Yoova tinim watooŋrau pani. Yoova lolo poia pa Abel toman watooŋrau toni.
Eemoghon Kain toman watooŋrau toni, Yoova irere pani. Tauto Kain ate yabyab kat le nagho isami.
Tovenen Yoova ighason Kain ighaze: “Pughu vena to atem yabyab ve naghom isami?

Ighaze yom ugham ŋgar deŋia, pale lolog poia payom ve tinim iza. Eemoghon ighaze ugham ŋgar to deŋia maau, yom upatum ghom. Pasa, ŋgar samia inepneep ataam tiom avo, ve isasaŋan ghom ighaze igham ghom unum le. Tovenen yom irau uyoon ariaŋa ve utatan ŋgar samia tonanan izi.” Ro 6:12
Muri ghoro, Kain isaav pa tazi Abel ighaze: “Unum ituru tala talaghlaagh uum lolo.” Yesuru tila tonowe, ghoro Kain imundig ve irab tazi Abel imaat. Mt 23:35; 1Yo 3:12
Tovenen Yoova ighason Kain ighaze: “Kain, tazim Abel ineep sine?” Kain ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “You nakankaan pani. Vena, you nanim ŋginiiŋ to tazig?”
Ghoro Yoova isaav pani muul ighaze: “Yom ugham ŋgar tovene pasa? Ulooŋ. Tazim siŋ toni to imaliŋ izi taan, tauto imboboob iza inim tiou. Hib 12:24
Yom urab tazim imaat, ve taan tonene ighun siŋ toni wa. Tovenen you pale naghur pataŋani tonene iŋarua ghom: Yom irau uneep muul izi taan tonene maau.
Ve ighaze uvazog aniiŋ izila taan to ndug ite paam, nene pale ughita anoŋa eta maau. Yom pale irau uneep tuŋia izi ndug eta maau. Pale uwalaghlaagh irau taan naol.”
Kain ilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve isaav pa Yoova ighaze: “Atia to sosor tiou to yom ughuri payou, nene pataŋani kat. Irau nambaada maau.

Ughita. Aazne, yom undiir ghou pa taan tonene ve ughaze nala naneep saguan payom. Ve ughaze you irau naneep tuŋia izi ndug eta maau. Pale nawalaghlaagh irau taan naol, ve ighaze ŋgeu eta ighita ghou, ye pale irab ghou namaat.”

Eemoghon Yoova isaav pani muul ighaze: “Maau. Ighaze ŋgeu eta irab ghom umaat, nene pale nayat ŋgeu tonanan sosor toni irau pa liim ve ru.” Ghoro Yoova ighur ghilalooŋ eez iza to Kain. Leso tamtoghon tighita ve tirabi sob.
Kain ipul Yoova, ve ilaagh ila ivot taan suruvu eez, iza Nod, ve ineep tonowe. Taan tonowen ineep uum Eden dige ila pa ndag iza.
Kain papaghu toni
Muri ghoro, Kain yesuru azuwa tigheen, ve liva apo ve ipoop natu aidaba, iza Anok. Ghoro Kain igharaat ndug tiina eez, ve iwaat natu Anok iza pani.
Anok natu Irad, Irad natu Mehuyael, Mehuyael natu Metusael, ve Metusael natu Lamek.
Lamek ivai ndiliva ru. Eez iza Ada, ve ite iza Zila.
Lamek azuwa Ada to ipoop Yabal. Yabal papaghu toni, nene yes to tilaghlaagh toman ŋgai todi, ve tinepneep ila mbeez to tigharaat di pa ŋgai ulidi.
Yabal tazi, iza Yubal. Papaghu toni, to tighagharaat sab to vibiiŋ ve mbeb pida tinimale gita.
Lamek azuwa ite Zila ipoop Tuval-Kain. Tuval-Kain papaghu toni, to tighagharaat ain ve baras tinim mbeb pida to uraat. Tuval-Kain livu iza Naama.
Sawa eez, Lamek isaav pa ndizuwa ru ighaze:

content.text: You Lamek ndizwag to yamru. Aghur taliŋamim pa saveeŋ tiou.
Ighaze ŋgeu eta irab ghou le siŋ tiou izi, you pale narabi imaat.
Ve ighaze pain eta ipambar ghou, nene pale narabi imaat paam.
Alooŋ. Ighaze tamtoghon eta irab Kain imaat, nene pale tiyat ŋgar toni irau pa liim ve ru.

content: Eemoghon you, ighaze tirab ghou namaat, nene pale tiyat ŋgar todi irau pa tamoot tol saaŋgul liim ve ru (77).”
Set ve Enos
Adam yesuru azuwa Eva tilup di muul, ve Eva apo, ve ipoop tamoot ite. Ye iwaat iza Set, ve isaav ighaze: “Kain irab tazi Abel imaat, tauto Maaron igham leg tamtoghon ite tonene leso igham ina.”
Muri ghoro, Set yesuru azuwa tipoop tamoot eez, ve Set iwaat iza Enos. Sawa tonenen, tamtoghon tipamundigin ŋgar to suŋuuŋ pa Yoova.
